proposals.before: After the Xianfeng era, the Beijing Copper Bureau also handled collections.
proposals.after: From the Xianfeng era onward, the Beijing Copper Bureau also handled collections.
proposals.reason: 咸豐後 marks time after Xianfeng began, not after that reign had ended; 'after the Xianfeng era' wrongly suggests the Tongzhi period.

proposals.before: In Yongzheng 12 (1734), the Henan grain-reserve transport purchase regulations were opened.
proposals.after: In Yongzheng 12 (1734), the advance grain-transport purchase regulations were opened.
proposals.reason: 豫籌糧運例 means regulations for grain transport planned in advance (豫籌), not a Henan (豫) grain-reserve scheme.

proposals.before: In the twelfth year, the Henan grain-reserve transport regulations were opened.
proposals.after: In the twelfth year, the advance grain-transport regulations were opened.
proposals.reason: Literal English also takes 豫 as Henan rather than 'in advance' in 豫籌.

proposals.before: An edict approved ranks up to central secretaries and compilers in the capital and sub-prefects and sub-circuit magistrates in the provinces, provided the regular route was not harmed.
proposals.after: An edict approved ranks from central secretaries, messengers, reviewers, and doctors downward in the capital, and from sub-prefects and assistant prefects downward in the provinces, provided the regular route was not harmed.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English collapses 中、行、評、博 to secretaries and compilers and misses 通判 as assistant prefect paired with 同知.

proposals.before: Once regulations opened, officials paid with stored grain; a tribute student buying immediate appointment as sub-prefect cost barely a thousand cash, a junior capital official only a few hundred—he requested requiring full payment in silver to stop abuses."
proposals.after: Once regulations opened, officials paid with stored grain; a tribute student buying immediate appointment as sub-prefect cost barely a thousand-odd taels, a junior capital official only a few hundred—he requested requiring full payment in silver to stop abuses."
proposals.reason: 千餘金 denotes taels of silver, not copper cash; the abuse contrast with 交銀 depends on that unit.

proposals.before: Once regulations were open, each official contributed with stored grain; calculating that a tribute student purchasing immediate-appointment sub-prefect cost no more than a thousand-odd in cash, and a junior capital official no more than several hundred, he requested ordering payment in silver at the full amount to stop abuses."
proposals.after: Once regulations were open, each official contributed with stored grain; calculating that a tribute student purchasing immediate-appointment sub-prefect cost no more than a thousand-odd taels, and a junior capital official no more than several hundred, he requested ordering payment in silver at the full amount to stop abuses."
proposals.reason: Literal English likewise renders 金 as cash; the source unit is silver taels.

proposals.before: Most regulations followed old practice; only the extended regulations allowed tribute licentiates to purchase Secretariat drafter posts, and the Henan works regulations allowed supplemental students to purchase educational posts.
proposals.after: Most regulations followed old practice; only the extended regulations allowed tribute licentiates to purchase Secretariat drafter posts, and the Henan works regulations allowed supplemental and attached students to purchase educational posts.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English drops 附 from 增、附捐教職, which the literal already preserves as attached students.

proposals.before: In the thirteenth year, Wuzhi in Henan and the Qin and Yellow Rivers at Zhengzhou burst their banks.
proposals.after: In the thirteenth year, the Qin and Yellow Rivers burst their banks at Wuzhi and Zhengzhou in Henan.
proposals.reason: The Chinese locates the Qin and Yellow River breaches at Wuzhi and Zhengzhou in Henan; the literal English makes Wuzhi itself burst alongside the rivers.

proposals.before: Censors Zhou Tianlin and Li Shijin successively requested opening Zhengzhou river-works purchase regulations to fund urgent repairs.
proposals.after: Censors Zhou Tianlin and Li Shikun successively requested opening Zhengzhou river-works purchase regulations to fund urgent repairs.
proposals.reason: 士錕 is Shikun; the English given name Shijin does not match the Chinese characters.

proposals.before: Censors Zhou Tianlin and Li Shijin successively requested opening Zhengzhou works regulations to aid urgent projects.
proposals.after: Censors Zhou Tianlin and Li Shikun successively requested opening Zhengzhou works regulations to aid urgent projects.
proposals.reason: 士錕 is Shikun; the English given name Shijin does not match the Chinese characters.

proposals.before: Thereafter clerical officials from purchased-academy backgrounds seeking promotion or purchasing chief posts in the capital or provinces had first to purchase exemption from recommendation; only permitted-tribute graduates were exempt.
proposals.after: Thereafter, clerks and men of purchased-academy background who wished to be promoted or to purchase chief posts in the capital or provinces had first to purchase exemption from recommendation; only permitted-tribute graduates were exempt.
proposals.reason: 吏員例監出身者 names two origin routes (clerks and purchased-academy students), not clerks who themselves came from the purchased academy.

proposals.before: During the Qianlong era regulations reopened repeatedly, but only for ordinary bi-monthly and monthly quotas—not the special prior-use or immediate-use categories.
proposals.after: During the Qianlong era regulations reopened repeatedly, but only ordinary quota categories such as bi-monthly, monthly, regardless-of-bi-monthly selection, bi-monthly prior-use, and regardless-of-bi-monthly-or-monthly immediate-use.
proposals.reason: 惟 introduces the listed 尋常班次; 不論雙月選用, 雙月先用, and 不論雙、單月即用 are quota names being included, not English negation excluding prior-use and immediate-use.

proposals.before: In the Qianlong years regulations were opened repeatedly, but only for bi-monthly and monthly ordinary quotas—not bi-monthly selection, bi-monthly prior use, or bi- and monthly immediate use.
proposals.after: In the Qianlong years regulations were opened repeatedly, but only ordinary quotas: bi-monthly, monthly, regardless-of-bi-monthly selection and bi-monthly prior-use, and regardless-of-bi-monthly-or-monthly immediate-use.
proposals.reason: 不論 here is part of established quota labels (不論雙月選用, 不論雙、單月即用), not the English word not excluding those categories from 尋常班次.

proposals.before: In Xianfeng 9, a succession of new quotas was established: new-quota vacancy, new-quota priority, split-vacancy priorities, and regardless-of-quota vacancy selection.
proposals.after: In Xianfeng 9, a succession of new quotas was established: new-quota vacancy, new-quota priority, split-vacancy pre-priority, split-vacancy inter-pre, full-quota pre-priority, and regardless-of-quota vacancy selection.
proposals.reason: The Chinese lists six named quotas (新班遇缺、新班侭先、分缺先前、分缺間前、本班侭先前、不論班侭遇缺選補); the idiomatic English fuses and omits several.

proposals.before: District magistrates had the regular route for supplementary appointment and were stingily not granted dispatch.
proposals.after: District magistrates, because they would obstruct supplementary appointment by the regular route, were stingily not granted dispatch.
proposals.reason: Chinese 有兒正途補用 is the common 有碍/有礙 corruption; 兒 is not a possession of the regular route.

proposals.before: That year the Ministry of War approved awaiting and candidate garrison commandants and company commanders purchasing dispatch and studying with grain transport, like civil officials.
proposals.after: That year the Ministry of War memorialized that awaiting and candidate garrison commandants and company commanders could purchase dispatch and study with grain transport, like civil officials.
proposals.reason: Chinese 奏請 is a request, not an approval; the literal field already has memorialized.

proposals.before: In Qianlong 46, awaiting registrars and candidate deputies petitioned the Ministry of Revenue: after long waits with no selection, provincial deputy quotas were clear—they requested purchase dispatch, and the old rule was restored.
proposals.after: In Qianlong 46, awaiting-appointment provincial administration registrar Zheng Zhaofang and others and candidate department assistant Zhang Yanling and others petitioned the Ministry of Revenue: after long waits with no selection, provincial deputy quotas were clear—they requested purchase dispatch, and the old rule was restored.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English omits the named petitioners 鄭肇芳 and 張衍齡 present in the Chinese and literal fields.

proposals.before: In Guangxu 8, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor He Jing reported: "Fujian examined 154 prefectural and county officials, 55 salt commissioners, and 596 deputies; prefects and salt commissioners were retained at fifty percent, sub-prefects and deputies at forty percent."
proposals.after: In Guangxu 8, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General He Jing reported: "Fujian examined 154 prefectural and county officials, 55 salt commissioners, and 596 deputies; prefects and salt commissioners were retained at fifty percent, sub-prefects and deputies at forty percent."
proposals.reason: 閩浙總督 is Governor-General, not Governor.

proposals.before: Thereafter tribute and academy examination for office was limited to department assistants, county assistants, registrars, and clerks.
proposals.after: Thereafter tribute and academy examination for office was limited to department assistants, department judges, county assistants, registrars, and clerks.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English omits 州判 (department judge) from the five posts 州同、州判、縣丞、主簿、吏目, collapsing the list.

proposals.before: When exposed, Wang Tanwang, Le Erjin, and Wang Tingzan were executed; dozens of officials were dismissed; contributors were barred from examinations, fined, or halted in selection.
proposals.after: When exposed, Wang Tanwang, Le Erjin, and Wang Tingzan were punished according to law; dozens of officials were dismissed; contributors were barred from examinations, fined, or halted in selection.
proposals.reason: 置於法 means they were dealt with by law, not specifically that they were executed; the literal field already has punished by law.

decisions.reason: 咸豐後 here continues the list of collection venues and marks time from the Xianfeng reign onward; the Beijing Copper Bureau began handling juan-na during Xianfeng, so “after the Xianfeng era” wrongly postpones the measure until after that reign ended.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 咸豐後，並由京銅局。

decisions.reason: 豫籌糧運例 is the “advance planning of grain transport” purchase schedule (豫籌 = plan in advance). Reading 豫 as Henan and 籌 as grain-reserve invents a provincial scheme; the later 豫工例 is the distinct Henan works schedule.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 十二年，開豫籌糧運例。

decisions.reason: The literal field repeats the same misreading of 豫籌 as Henan grain-reserve. 豫籌 means planning in advance, not the province 豫.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 開豫籌糧運例

decisions.after: An edict approved ranks from central secretaries, messengers, reviewers, and doctors downward in the capital, and from sub-prefects and sub-circuit magistrates downward in the provinces, provided the regular route was not harmed.
decisions.reason: 京官中、行、評、博以下 names four capital offices (中書、行人、評事、博士) and all ranks below them; “up to … compilers” both truncates the list and reverses 以下. 同知、通判以下 is already rendered in this chapter as sub-prefects and sub-circuit magistrates, so the proposed switch to assistant prefects is unnecessary.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 詔以京官中、行、評、博以下，外官同知、通判以下，無礙正途，如所請行。

decisions.reason: 千餘金 and 數百金 are silver-tael sums, set against 交銀. Rendering 金 as copper cash invents the wrong unit and blunts the abuse Zhang Guangsi is describing.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 計貢監納即用同知不過千餘金，即用小京官不過數百金，請令如數交銀

decisions.reason: The literal likewise turns 金 into cash. The surrounding 捐銀二十五兩 and 交銀 show the unit is silver taels.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 不過千餘金

decisions.reason: 增、附捐教職 names two student statuses, zengsheng and fusheng. Dropping 附 omits attached students, whom the next sentence also pairs as 增、附.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 豫工例中准增、附捐教職

decisions.reason: 河南武陟，鄭州沁、黃兩河漫決 locates Qin and Yellow River breaches at Wuzhi and Zhengzhou in Henan. The original literal makes Wuzhi itself burst beside the rivers.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 河南武陟，鄭州沁、黃兩河漫決

decisions.reason: 李士錕 is Li Shikun (錕 = kun). Shijin does not match the given name 士錕.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 御史周天霖、李士錕

decisions.reason: The same given-name error appears in the literal field: 士錕 is Shikun, not Shijin.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 李士錕

decisions.reason: 吏員例監出身者 is two origin routes, clerks and men of purchased-jiansheng background, not clerks who themselves came from the purchased academy.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 吏員例監出身者

decisions.after: During the Qianlong era regulations reopened repeatedly, but only for ordinary quota categories such as bi-monthly, monthly, regardless-of-bi-monthly selection, bi-monthly prior-use, and regardless-of-bi-monthly-or-monthly immediate-use.
decisions.reason: 惟 … 等尋常班次 includes the listed labels; 不論雙月選用, 雙月先用, and 不論雙、單月即用 are ordinary quota names, not English negation excluding prior-use and immediate-use. The proposed sentence is accurate but needs for to remain grammatical.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 惟雙月、單月，不論雙月選用及雙月先用，不論雙、單月即用等尋常班次

decisions.reason: The literal field likewise treats 不論 as ‘not.’ In this list 不論 is part of the quota titles 不論雙月選用 and 不論雙、單月即用 under 尋常班次.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 不論雙月選用及雙月先用，不論雙、單月即用等尋常班次

decisions.reason: The Chinese enumerates six named quotas: 新班遇缺、新班侭先、分缺先前、分缺間前、本班侭先前、不論班侭遇缺選補. “Split-vacancy priorities” fuses and drops 分缺先前, 分缺間前, and 本班侭先前.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 新班遇缺、新班侭先、分缺先前，分缺間前、本班侭先前、不論班侭遇缺選補等班

decisions.reason: 有兒正途補用 is the character 礙 (石+兒) mis-encoded as 兒, i.e. 有礙正途補用. Gao Pu’s next sentence 恐有兒舉班 is already translated as fear of harming the juren quota. CText and Wikisource print the same 兒 graph; the sense is obstruction, not possession of the regular route.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 知縣有兒正途補用，靳不與。四十年，兵部侍郎高樸言：「捐班知縣，不許分發，恐有兒舉班。

decisions.reason: 是年兵部奏請 is a memorial requesting the measure. Approval comes only with 均報可 in the following sentences; saying the Ministry of War approved conflates petitioner and throne.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 是年兵部奏請候補、候選衛守備、衛千總

sourceWitness.excerpt: 候補布政司經歷鄭肇芳等、候選州同張衍齡等具呈戶部
